name: Frustrated
definition: A sense of being blocked or stalled by an obstacle outside your immediate control.
body_signals: Tight jaw, shallow breath, tension in shoulders and upper chest.
triggers: Unresponsive colleague, delays, broken tools, repetitive roadblocks.
need: Clarity on what is within my agency right now versus what must wait.
now_action: Pause typing. Name what is blocked in one sentence. Step away from the screen for 2 minutes.
after_action: Identify the smallest unblocked step you can take autonomously.
over_time: Notice recurring bottlenecks and propose structural fixes during calm periods.
never_do: Never fire off an escalating Slack message or email while shoulders are raised.

name: Enraged
definition: Overwhelming surge of anger where impulse control is critically compromised.
body_signals: Pounding pulse, clenched fists, heat in face, tunnel vision.
triggers: Severe breach of trust, public humiliation, perceived injustice.
need: Immediate physical de-escalation and containment before any words are exchanged.
now_action: Execute the 60-second reset. Physically leave the room or close the laptop. Drink cold water.
after_action: Do not send any reply until at least 2 hours have passed and heart rate has normalized.
over_time: Explore underlying boundary violations with a coach or trusted mentor.
never_do: Never speak, type, drive, or commit to any decision while intensity is 9 or 10.

name: Anxious
definition: Anticipatory dread regarding future uncertainties or potential negative outcomes.
body_signals: Fluttering stomach, restlessness, dry mouth, rapid heartbeat.
triggers: Upcoming performance review, ambiguous feedback, financial uncertainty.
need: Grounding in present reality and distinguishing facts from imagined catastrophe.
now_action: Use the 'Story vs Fact' tool. List 3 tangible facts true right here in this room.
after_action: Schedule a specific 15-minute 'worry window' later today instead of ruminating now.
over_time: Build gradual exposure to uncertainty through small, manageable risks.
never_do: Never seek endless reassurance online or poll multiple colleagues frantically.

name: Panicked
definition: Acute state of physiological fight-flight-freeze overwhelmed by perceived imminent threat.
body_signals: Hyperventilation, dizziness, chest tightness, urge to bolt.
triggers: Sudden crisis, confrontation, sensory overload, unexpected shock.
need: Somatic safety anchor and autonomic nervous system regulation.
now_action: Launch the 60-Second Reset. Feet flat on floor, 4-count inhale, 6-count long exhale.
after_action: Touch 5 physical objects around you. State their colors aloud.
over_time: Consult medical professional or coach if panic spikes regularly without external cause.
never_do: Never force cognitive problem-solving while body is in acute panic.

name: Discouraged
definition: Loss of confidence or enthusiasm following a setback or repeated effort without reward.
body_signals: Heavy limbs, slumped posture, low energy, sighing.
triggers: Rejected proposal, missed target, lack of acknowledgment.
need: Compassionate acknowledgment of effort and permission to rest without quitting.
now_action: Acknowledge: 'This was hard and the outcome hurts.' Rest for 30 minutes without guilt.
after_action: Review previous moments of resilience in your EQ OS Mirror.
over_time: Recalibrate expectations and detach self-worth from single transaction outcomes.
never_do: Never make a sweeping career or relationship resignation decision today.

name: Despairing
definition: Profound sense of hopelessness where the future feels devoid of positive possibilities.
body_signals: Hollow chest, exhaustion, inability to focus, weeping or emotional numbness.
triggers: Prolonged loss, burnout, isolation, perceived helplessness.
need: Human connection and crisis safety check.
now_action: Connect immediately to support. Tap 'Support now' for Tele-MANAS (14416) or reach out to a trusted human.
after_action: Request follow-up from on-call Drishta Vidya coach.
over_time: Engage structured professional human counselling and support circles.
never_do: Never isolate alone in secrecy when sadness reaches 8-10.

name: Mortified / Exposed
definition: The painful belief that you are fundamentally flawed, seen, and unworthy.
body_signals: Blushing, shrinking inward, looking down, sick feeling in gut.
triggers: Public error, reprimand, perceived social faux pas.
need: Self-compassion and distinguishing behavior ('I made a mistake') from identity ('I am a mistake').
now_action: Use the 'What would you say to a friend?' tool. Speak gently to yourself.
after_action: Share the experience with one safe, non-judgmental confidant.
over_time: Practice shame resilience through open vulnerability in safe spaces.
never_do: Never attack others defensively to deflect attention from your vulnerability.

name: Regretful
definition: Painful awareness of having acted against your personal values or hurt another.
body_signals: Gnawing sensation in stomach, furrowed brow, internal heaviness.
triggers: Snapping at a team member, broken promise, neglecting family commitment.
need: Clean acknowledgment, sincere apology, and constructive restitution.
now_action: Open the 'Repair' conversation script. Prepare a simple 3-part clean apology.
after_action: Deliver the apology without making excuses or defending yourself.
over_time: Align daily actions with stated core values.
never_do: Never bury guilt into passive-aggressive avoidance.

name: Grounded
definition: A centered, steady state where thoughts are clear and emotional reactivity is minimal.
body_signals: Relaxed shoulders, deep diaphragmatic breathing, steady posture.
triggers: Completed meaningful task, peaceful environment, mindful pause.
need: Savoring and anchoring the state into memory.
now_action: Take 3 conscious breaths. Notice the stillness in your chest.
after_action: Record this in your 'Moments I Handled Well' log.
over_time: Use this state as your reference baseline for detecting early stress triggers.
never_do: Never immediately rush to check notifications and disrupt the calm.

name: Energized
definition: Vibrant vitality and optimism ready to engage constructively with others.
body_signals: Lightness in chest, open smile, upright posture, warm eyes.
triggers: Breakthrough idea, team win, deep connection, recognition.
need: Shared celebration and channeling energy into purposeful momentum.
now_action: Use the 'Savor It' tool. Send a quick word of gratitude to someone who helped.
after_action: Channel this energy into one high-leverage creative task.
never_do: Never over-commit impulsively to new obligations while riding a high.

name: Repelled
definition: Strong moral or physical distaste toward a behavior, environment, or violation of ethics.
body_signals: Curled upper lip, nausea, pulling backward, crossed arms.
triggers: Hypocrisy, unfair scapegoating, toxic workplace behavior.
need: Clarifying ethical boundaries and creating protective distance.
now_action: Step back physically. Write down exactly what line was crossed.
after_action: Decide on a professional, firm boundary rather than contemptuous gossip.
over_time: Advocate for institutional integrity and psychological safety.
never_do: Never engage in petty workplace sabotage.
